review_scope: Existing saved row/pair/bucket/coverage records and source/protocol/admission hashes, execution record and final findings only. No matching algorithm rerun, source re-audit, raw QA/image access, processor/model/tensor call, score or bootstrap.
findings: The fixed pairing covers natural 6 QA, medical 13 QA in tasks 4/5/6/11, geography 20 QA in 11 groups, finance 4 QA and traffic 18 QA; these are geometry-conditioned dependent observations, not an independently representative domain sample.
The predefined coverage gate passes. This removes one feasibility obstacle and supports drafting a separate bounded four-state model proposal; it does not authorize running that proposal.
Actual text tokens, visual placeholders, masks, positions and packed layouts have not been checked. Geometry equality is insufficient to assert content-only image intervention.

The corrected final findings require the relative contrast D=DeltaC_OSFT minus DeltaC_qv to be positive, with both methods original-image NLL improvements and their relative difference reported; OSFT self-increase alone cannot explain an advantage over qv.

A later controlled result could constrain the input-conditioned gold-support function a compact carrier should retain. It cannot select a rank, layer, sparsity, visual/language deletion or compression family, or establish an original paper framework.
limitations: No mechanism or quality direction has yet been measured; this metadata result is not evidence that OSFT learned more visual knowledge or that any model ignores images.
Future reconstructed unadapted states are not historical S0 bitwise reproductions; each method needs its own explicitly bound state and the common inference path.

A full-row.answer likelihood target differs from the original training helper truncation at 512 tokens plus EOS; that difference, actual target handling, resource budget and input checks require separate review.
Counterfactual/gold validity, modality, near-duplicates, answer-prefix effects and calibration remain limits even if a later model implementation passes layout checks.

The reported consumer 1.5849854719999712 seconds lies inside the 7.155181880021701-second supervisor interval; they are not additive. The first failed import and its missing original stderr remain disclosed separately.
next_action: Only prepare a separately reviewed finite model protocol and source if still scientifically worthwhile; no new training, repair, activation or model READY follows from this review.
